scope: static audit of the inference/evaluation paths at HEAD 47d1063 (uncommitted two-class files) for GT/label/position/oracle/file-name leakage into identity-bearing inference; no dynamic inference was run by this audit

audited_shas.concurrent_edit_caveat: the two-class eval module/CLI are being edited by parallel tasks; line numbers are for the shas above and must be re-checked at the P2 freeze

checks.requirement: the model is called with the image only
checks.evidence: scripts/evaluate_landmark_yolo.py:151-152 model.predict(source=str(frame['image_path']), imgsz=..., conf=0.01); scripts/evaluate_landmark_two_class.py:136-138 model.predict(source=str(image_path), imgsz=..., conf=..., device=...)

checks.requirement: the decoder receives no GT geometry/class/position
checks.evidence: landmark_yolo.decode_ultralytics_result args = results[0], image dims, intrinsics, thresholds, frame_id, image (evaluate_landmark_yolo.py:153-158); decode_candidates consumes candidates+dims+intrinsics+thresholds only

checks.requirement: the consumer/deployment path uses only the v2 observation payload and detector prior
checks.evidence: landmark_consumer.py:123-128 image_path = payload.ref; detector.detect(image_path, intrinsics); landmark_detector.py:3-5 docstring and 42-43 detect signature

checks.requirement: identity claims come from predicted class/score/bbox/keypoint only
checks.evidence: landmark_two_class_eval.decode_detections: class0-only claim, class1 never maps to the tower id, conflict/margin rejection; no GT fields read inside decode except frame_id

checks.requirement: no oracle region / GT position / file-name parsing in inference decisions
checks.evidence: decode functions never parse file names and do not read oracle/position fields; the image string is stored only

checks.requirement: GT row is not passed into the inference decode API
checks.evidence: scripts/evaluate_landmark_two_class.py:140-141 decode_detections(detections, truth_row, ...); src/.../landmark_two_class_eval.py:396 signature includes truth_row, and the only use inside decode is truth_row.get('frame_id') at :438

checks.requirement: evaluation image resolution / pairing does not feed GT values to the model
checks.evidence: scripts/evaluate_landmark_two_class.py:60-64 _resolve_image(images_dir, truth_row) uses truth_row image/frame_id to locate the file; the model then receives only the path. This is evaluation pairing, not an inference input; the deployment path uses payload.ref (G3).

checks.requirement: labels are used only after inference for scoring
checks.evidence: evaluate_landmark_yolo.py loads the label document before inference only for image resolution/frame ids; evaluate_frame/GT matching runs after predictions. No GT value is passed into predict/decode. This is documented as an evaluation-plane property, not a deployment property.

finding.severity: MEDIUM (architectural coupling; currently no value leak)
finding.description: the two-class inference decoder API takes the full truth_row. Current code reads only frame_id, so no GT value leaks today, but the signature makes a future GT leak easy and makes a 'no GT input' claim harder to prove by construction.
finding.required_resolution: refactor decode_detections to take frame_id (str) instead of truth_row, and keep truth_row in evaluate_frame only; do this before P2 smoke sign-off
finding.required_test: GT-poison invariance: mutate every GT geometry/class/keypoint field in the truth rows, keep frame ids, run the same inference/decode path and assert observations are byte-identical (only scoring rows may change); a second test renames image files/tower-vs-ms1 tokens and asserts identical observations

required_p2_tests: GT-poison invariance for --model and --predictions paths (mutate labels; observations identical)
image file-name independence (rename with misleading class tokens; observations identical)
decode API signature contains no truth_row/annotation/gt parameter (static test or AST check)
class1 never emits landmark_id and never emits a keypoint reference, even if the predicted class1 keypoint confidence is high
class conflict (class0 and class1 IoU >= tau_conflict) -> UNKNOWN/REJECTED, not a tower claim
static guard: no 'oracle', 'ground_truth', 'target_world', 'position' access inside the inference/decode functions
single-class baseline adapter cannot set class1 or a class1 keypoint
boundaries: static code audit only; no dynamic inference was run in this audit
the two-class model does not exist yet (P1/P3 pending)
not a certification of the deployment path
